_comment: SHA-256 manifest of the RapidOCR ONNX models this app is built against. RapidOCREngine.models_present() verifies bundled files match by name AND hash so a missing, truncated, or swapped model fails closed with a local error instead of any download. Regenerate after a deliberate model upgrade with: python -m app.pipeline.engines.rapidocr_models --write
